title: Lily Pad Recipes [Biomes We've Gone]
description: Add some lily pad related recipes, such as converting minecraft lily pads to BWG tiny lily pads, and create flowering lily pads.
body:
This datapack adds a couple of recipes to allow crafting Biomes We've Gone Lily pads from minecraft lily pads.

Recipes are shapeless, just add a minecraft lily pad to a crafting slot to convert it to a Biomes We've Gone tiny lily pad, or do the reverse to get a minecraft lily pad.

Flowering lily pads can also be created by putting a minecraft or biomes we've gone flower (with the flower tag) into a crafting slot with a (MC) lily pad or (BWG) tiny lily pad.

![A minecraft lily pad in a crafting slot to show the result of a (BWG) tiny lily pad.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7aaa566411eb9e85bcf3c69b446805793aa7965.png)

![A minecraft lily pad and flower being crafted into a (BWG) tiny lily pad.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e67a32e9683ff7aa0f7fce63b3fcef8b163badd0.png)

![(BWG) Tiny lily pad and flower crafting recipe showing a flowering tiny lily pad result.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3f36cf6f9289a5afaff996224254062e6f1aa07e.png)
